title: Dance

sourceText.admission:
Admission Requirements

Applicants who meet the following requirements are accepted during autumn, winter, and spring quarters on a rolling basis.

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA

• Successful completion of 3 credits in any of the academic courses required for the major.

• Successful completion of or registration in at least one dance technique course.

sections.programCompletionRequirements:
Completion Requirements

Minimum 56 credits

• Core Courses (25 credits): DANCE 166, DANCE 242, DANCE 271 (1 credit), DANCE 349, DANCE 356 (5 credits), DANCE 493 (5 credits), DANCE 494 (3 credits)

• Dance Studies Courses (6-10 credits): See adviser for list of approved courses.

• Dance Electives (3-7 credits): to reach minimum 38 credits in core, dance studies, and dance electives

• Technique/Practice Courses: Minimum 18 credits from list of approved courses, representing at least four different movement idioms.

• Minimum 25 credits at the 300- or 400-level

• Minimum 2.00 cumulative GPA for courses applied to the major
